arxiv-2102-09490.title: Mean-Based Trace Reconstruction over Oblivious Synchronization Channels
arxiv-2102-09490.creator: Mahdi Cheraghchi, Joseph Downs, João Ribeiro, Alexandra Veliche
arxiv-2102-09490.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mahdi Cheraghchi, Joseph Downs, João Ribeiro, Alexandra Veliche. Mean-based reconstruction is a fundamental, natural approach to worst-case trace reconstruction over channels with synchronization errors. It is known that exp ⁡ ( Θ ⁡ ( n 1 / 3 ) ) \exp(\Theta(n^{1/3})) traces are necessary and sufficient for mean-based worst-case trace reconstruction over the deletion channel, and this result was also extended to certain channels combining deletions and geometric insertions of uniformly random bits.

arxiv-2202-02320.title: A dynamic program to achieve capacity of multiple access channel with noiseless feedback
arxiv-2202-02320.creator: Deepanshu Vasal
arxiv-2202-02320.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the problem of evaluating capacity expression of a multiple access channel (MAC) with noiseless feedback. So far, the capacity expression for this channel is known through a multi letter directed information by Kramer [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2203-15000.title: The Lick AGN Monitoring Project 2016: Dynamical Modeling of Velocity-Resolved H β \beta Lags in Luminous Seyfert Galaxies
arxiv-2203-15000.creator: Lizvette Villafaña, Peter R. Williams, Tommaso Treu, Brendon J. Brewer, Aaron J. Barth, Vivian U, Vardha N. Bennert, H. Alexander Vogler, Hengxiao Guo, Misty C. Bentz, Gabriela Canalizo, Alexei V. Filippenko, Elinor Gates, Frederick Hamann, Michael D. Joner, Matthew A. Malkan, Jong-Hak Woo, Bela Abo
arxiv-2203-15000.description: Abstract We have modeled the velocity-resolved reverberation response of the H β \beta broad emission line in nine Seyfert 1 galaxies from the Lick Active Galactic Nucleus (AGN) Monitioring Project 2016 sample, drawing inferences on the geometry and structure of the low-ionization broad-line region (BLR) and the mass of the central supermassive black hole.

arxiv-2405-06871.title: Statistical Error of Numerical Integrators for Underdamped Langevin Dynamics with Deterministic And Stochastic Gradients
arxiv-2405-06871.creator: Xuda Ye, Zhennan Zhou
arxiv-2405-06871.description: Abstract We propose a novel discrete Poisson equation approach to estimate the statistical error of a broad class of numerical integrators for the underdamped Langevin dynamics. The statistical error refers to the mean square error of the estimator to the exact ensemble average with a finite number of iterations.

arxiv-2504-00543.title: Generalization-aware Remote Sensing Change Detection via Domain-agnostic Learning
arxiv-2504-00543.creator: Qi Zang, Shuang Wang, Dong Zhao, Dou Quan, Yang Hu, Zhi Yang, Licheng Jiao
arxiv-2504-00543.description: Abstract Change detection has essential significance for the region’s development, in which pseudo-changes between bitemporal images induced by imaging environmental factors are key challenges. Existing transformation-based methods regard pseudo-changes as a kind of style shift and alleviate it by transforming bitemporal images into the same style using generative adversarial networks (GANs).

arxiv-2505-00252.title: Emergent Synaptic Plasticity from Tunable Dynamics of Probabilistic Bits
arxiv-2505-00252.creator: Sagnik Banerjee, Shiva T. Konakanchi, Supriyo Datta, Pramey Upadhyaya
arxiv-2505-00252.description: Abstract Probabilistic (p-) computing, which leverages the stochasticity of its building blocks (p-bits) to solve a variety of computationally hard problems, has recently emerged as a promising physics-inspired hardware accelerator platform. A functionality of importance for p-computers is the ability to program–and reprogram–the interaction strength between arbitrary p-bits on-chip.

britannica-1911-lava.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lava.description: Article 'Lava' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. to the liquid products of volcanic activity. Streams of rain-water, formed by condensation of exhaled steam often mingled with volcanic ashes so as to produce mud, are known as lava d’acqua, whilst the streams of molten matter are called lava di fuoco. The term lava is applied by geologists to all matter of volcanic origin, which is, or has been, in a molten state.

pmc-10555947.title: Awareness of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease and Its Risk Factors Among the Adult Population of the Qassim Region, Saudi Arabia
pmc-10555947.creator: Ahmed S Almuzaini, Mutab Algeffari, Asma Alsohaibani, Latifah Y Almutlaq, Raghad Alwehaibi, Reema A Almuzaini, Syed E Mahmood
pmc-10555947.description: Background: Epidemiological studies are crucial in appraising the occurrence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in a specific region, establishing benchmarks, and devising effective preventive measures. It is against this background that the study aims to evaluate adult awareness of COPD and its risk factors among adults in the Qassim Region, Saudi Arabia.

pmc-11489328.title: Obesity in patients with craniopharyngioma in the South Asian region – A distinct phenotype
pmc-11489328.creator: Sreevatsa Tatachar, Remya Rajan, Asha Hesaraghatta Shyamsunder, Nitin Kapoor
pmc-11489328.description: BackgroundCraniopharyngiomas are rare benign tumors located in the sellar and suprasellar region, with an incidence of 0.5–2 cases per million as reported in Western studies. Post-treatment, including surgery and/or radiotherapy, many patients develop significant obesity, primarily due to hypothalamic damage and associated complications such as hypopituitarism.

pmc-13366782.title: Adipose tissue-derived mesenchymal stem cells combined with prednisone synergistically ameliorate autoimmune hepatitis in mice
pmc-13366782.creator: Jinfeng Kong, Xiuhui Liang, Geng Chen, Xiaolong Liu, Naishun Liao, Dongliang Li
pmc-13366782.description: BackgroundThe combination of adipose tissue–derived mesenchymal stem cell (ADSC) transplantation with conventional therapy for autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) represents a critical step toward the clinical translation of ADSC-based therapeutics. However, no preclinical studies have yet reported on such combination therapy for AIH.

pmc-13399829.title: Simplifying Iliotibial Band Lateral Extra‐articular Tenodesis Fixation During Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Hardware‐Sparing Approach
pmc-13399829.creator: Emmanouil Papakostas, Enejd Veizi, Ashraf Hantouly, Aizel Sherief Palasseril, Merve Bozer Kavukcu, Alan Getgood
pmc-13399829.description: The addition of a lateral extra‐articular tenodesis to anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction has been shown to reduce graft failure and improve rotational stability, but current fixation methods often require additional tunnels or hardware, with risks of tunnel convergence, irritation, and hardware removal.

pmc-13586456.title: Short-Term Efficacy of Tegoprazan Compared With Esomeprazole in Patients With Non-Erosive Reflux Disease and Nocturnal Heartburn Symptoms: A Double-Blind, Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13586456.creator: Jin Lee, Seong Je Kim, Yong Eun Park, Joon Hyuk Choi, Nae-Yun Heo, Seung Ha Park, Tae Oh Kim
pmc-13586456.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Objectives Tegoprazan is a novel potassium-competitive acid blocker that rapidly suppresses acid secretion. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of tegoprazan 50 mg compared with esomeprazole 20 mg in patients with non-erosive reflux disease and nocturnal heartburn symptoms.Methods This double-blind, randomized, active-control study was conducted to compare the efficacy of tegoprazan 50 mg and esomeprazole 20 mg in patients with non-erosive reflux disease and nocturnal heartburn symptoms. The primary endpoint was the percentage of nocturnal heartburn-free days over 2 weeks.

pmc-13617059.title: CT-guided three-dimensional reconstruction with predictive modeling for personalized esophageal anastomosis in type C esophageal atresia
pmc-13617059.creator: Vassiliy Lozovoy, Zhenis Sakuov, Assylzhan Yerekeshov, Dastan Rustemov, Ruslan Bilal, Temirlan Zhangaskanov, Zariat Shatkenova
pmc-13617059.description: BackgroundAnastomotic stricture remains the most common and clinically significant complication following primary repair of type C esophageal atresia. Despite various technical modifications, postoperative narrowing at the anastomotic site continues to occur. We describe an approach incorporating preoperative three-dimensional CT reconstruction to enable individualized planning of the esophageal anastomosis.
